name: Siege Skytrooper
description: Siege Skytroopers were a skytrooper variant used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. Several times larger than a regular Human-sized version skytrooper, the Siege Skytroopers was powerful enough to go face-to-face with a walker. During the Assault on Odessen in 3630 BBY, a Siege Skytrooper was encountered by the Alliance Commander.
